responsibility: This header defines the interface and enums for the BPF backend’s CO-RE builtin subsystem. It assigns builtin IDs for packet-load helpers and the various CO-RE/preserve_* intrinsics, defines the user-visible relocation-kind selector enums for field, type-id, type-info, and enum-value queries, and declares the global builtin table plus the initialization, overload-resolution, RTL expansion, and final-output helpers implemented by core-builtins.cc.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the declaration side of the core-builtins pair by defining the builtin-number namespace, user-visible kind enums for CO-RE queries, the builtin table, and function prototypes; the paired core-builtins.cc provides the actual lowering, expansion, relocation processing, and pass implementation.
